name: SOL volume-confirmed reversal
description: SOL: right after a 15-minute window opens, if the previous window moved more than 1.25 sigma on Binance volume more than twice the usual for that quarter-hour slot, buy the reversal side. Heavy-volume moves are forced flow (liquidations, stop runs) that unwinds; thin-volume moves persist.
hypothesis: The z1 open-reversal edge has decayed to ~+0.5c overall on all coins, but dev screens show it persists after heavy-volume moves (relv>2 +4.1c, >3 +5.7c; low-volume moves ~0; top tercile positive in 5/7 months). Forced flow overshoots and unwinds; Kalshi's open price ignores volume. Losers: takers treating the new window as a coin flip. Wrong if the walk-forward CI <= 0, or the lockbox loses.
next: Lockbox pass (weak). Before paper: needs a live Binance SOL volume stream (flow isn't streamed by the recorder); rv_scale 1.11 as sol-midrev. Overlaps sol-midrev/eth-overreact trades (same family), so count as one piece of evidence.
